letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every cool breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. Your smile lights up my mornings, and your laughter is the soundtrack of my evenings. Even as the calendar flips to a new season, my love for you remains timeless—warm as the desert sun, gentle as the monsoon rain. Thank you for being my cutie, my confidante, my forever partner in this adventure called us.
poem:
In deserts bright or monsoon’s sigh,  
Your love’s the star that paints the sky.  
Together we dance, hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
